name: Expert_AMS_ES_Stoch
summary: This EA uses a custom Stochastic oscillator signal filter (CMS_ES_Stoch) combined with a moving average to generate trade entries and exits within the MetaQuotes standard expert framework. It employs fixed lot money management and no trailing stop, relying purely on the signal thresholds for open/close decisions. The strategy targets overbought/oversold reversals based on Stochastic readings filtered by a short-period moving average.
summary_zh: 该EA使用自定义随机振荡器信号过滤器(CMS_ES_Stoch)结合移动平均线，在MetaQuotes标准专家框架内生成交易入场和出场信号。采用固定手数资金管理且无追踪止损，完全依赖信号阈值进行开平仓决策。策略基于随机指标的超买超卖反转信号并结合短期均线过滤。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于随机振荡器(Stochastic)的均值回归交易，通过自定义信号类CMS_ES_Stoch实现。入场条件由随机指标的K周期(12)、D周期(8)和慢速周期(29)参数决定，当指标值进入超买或超卖区域时产生信号，同时用4周期移动平均线作为辅助过滤。出场条件依赖于信号阈值机制，开仓阈值设为40，平仓阈值设为20，当信号强度低于平仓阈值时自动平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数模式(CMoneyFixedLot)，默认手数为0.1，不进行动态仓位调整。资金管理方面设置了10%的百分比参数，但由于使用固定手数，该参数实际仅影响可用保证金计算而非动态加仓。止损和止盈均设为0，意味着完全依赖信号反转来平仓，缺乏硬性风险保护。无追踪止损设置(CTrailingNone)，挂单有效期为4根K线。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is mean reversion trading based on a Stochastic oscillator, implemented through the custom signal class CMS_ES_Stoch. Entry conditions are determined by Stochastic parameters with K period (12), D period (8), and slowing period (29), generating signals when the indicator enters overbought or oversold zones, with a 4-period moving average as an auxiliary filter. Exit conditions rely on a signal threshold mechanism, with an open threshold of 40 and a close threshold of 20, automatically closing positions when signal strength falls below the close threshold. Position sizing uses a fixed lot model (CMoneyFixedLot) with a default of 0.1 lots and no dynamic position adjustment. Money management sets a 10% percent parameter, but since fixed lots are used, this only affects margin calculation rather than dynamic sizing. Both Stop Loss and Take Profit are set to 0, meaning the EA relies entirely on signal reversal for exits without hard risk protection. No trailing stop is configured (CTrailingNone), and pending orders expire after 4 bars.

parameters.name: Signal__StochApplied
parameters.description: 随机指标价格应用方式

pros: 使用MetaQuotes标准专家框架，代码结构清晰规范，模块化程度高
随机振荡器是成熟的均值回归指标，在震荡市场中表现良好
采用信号阈值机制而非简单交叉，提供了更灵活的入场/出场控制
固定手数降低了因仓位计算错误导致过度交易的风险
挂单有效期设置(4根K线)避免了过时订单长时间挂盘
pros_en: Uses the MetaQuotes standard expert framework with clear, modular code structure
Stochastic oscillator is a proven mean reversion indicator that performs well in ranging markets
Signal threshold mechanism provides more flexible entry/exit control than simple crossovers
Fixed lot sizing reduces the risk of over-trading due to position calculation errors
Pending order expiration (4 bars) prevents stale orders from lingering indefinitely
cons: 止损和止盈均设为0，缺乏硬性风险保护，在趋势行情中可能造成重大亏损
无追踪止损(CTrailingNone)，无法锁定浮盈，盈利可能大幅回吐
4周期MA过滤期太短，几乎无实际过滤效果，容易产生虚假信号
未检查新K线(EveryTick=false但无显式new bar检查)，可能在同一K线重复交易
未包含点差过滤，在点差较大时段交易可能直接亏损
信号权重固定为1.0且仅有一个过滤器，无法实现多信号确认
cons_en: Stop Loss and Take Profit are both set to 0, lacking hard risk protection which can cause significant losses in trending markets
No trailing stop (CTrailingNone) means floating profits cannot be locked and may reverse entirely
The 4-period MA filter is too short to provide meaningful filtering, easily generating false signals
No explicit new bar check despite EveryTick=false, potentially causing repeated trades on the same bar
No spread filter included, trading during high-spread periods can result in immediate losses
Signal weight is fixed at 1.0 with only one filter, preventing multi-signal confirmation
improvements: 添加止损和止盈参数，至少设置一个合理的默认止损以保护资金安全
增加点差过滤和新K线检查机制，避免在高点差时段和同一K线重复开仓
使用更长期的移动平均线(如20或50周期)作为趋势过滤，减少震荡行情中的虚假信号
添加追踪止损模块替代CTrailingNone，以在盈利交易中保护浮盈
考虑增加额外的信号过滤器(如RSI或ATR)实现多信号确认，提高交易质量
improvements_en: Add Stop Loss and Take Profit parameters with at least a reasonable default SL to protect capital
Implement spread filtering and new bar checks to avoid trading during high-spread periods and duplicate entries on the same bar
Use a longer-period moving average (e.g., 20 or 50 periods) as a trend filter to reduce false signals in choppy markets
Add a trailing stop module to replace CTrailingNone, protecting floating profits in winning trades
Consider adding additional signal filters (e.g., RSI or ATR) for multi-signal confirmation to improve trade quality

risk_points: 止损止盈均为0，完全依赖信号平仓，在极端行情下可能无法及时平仓导致巨额亏损
无追踪止损，盈利交易可能完全回吐
无点差过滤，交易成本可能被忽视
4周期MA过滤效果极弱，虚假信号风险高
risk_points_en: SL/TP both at 0 means complete reliance on signal-based exits, risking catastrophic losses in extreme market conditions
No trailing stop allows profitable trades to fully reverse into losses
No spread filter means trading costs may be ignored
4-period MA filter is extremely weak, high risk of false signals
